## 席位核对 · PR #27163 ← #27054 · epic PM `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` · 2026-10-28T09:27Z

Verdict: **REWORK (patch round on this PR, same claim)** — not governed (0 of 27 paths; `packages/spec` untouched), +1573 / −152. The report on the card (comment 6464856235) is read and accepted as filed: 34 / 34 gates exit 0 with the `--ran` reconciliation, two ablations red-then-restored, the live Studio run that caught the convert-to-full persisted-shape defect. The seat's spot checks on `23a697c2` hold: `anchors.ts` seeds a record page `slotted` unless the author picked `full`; `createDerive.ts`'s `page-kind` transform; `RelatedListFields` reads `true` / absent as Show, writes `false` / `'primary'`, deletes the key for Show, absent on `tree`; `relatedListFilter` goes through the one shared `FilterConditionField`.

Why rework — one red that is this PR's, pinned to head `23a697c2`: `Test UI (9/16)` fails `packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.agreement-12442.test.ts` (3 cases: "the page carries exactly one record:details node: expected [] to have a length of 1", and the CONTROL "expected undefined to deeply equal [ { name: 'main', … } ]"; job 122723053671). That pin (objectui#12442) asserts the page-create seed carries the runtime's detail sections — the very behaviour this card retires: a new record page is `slotted` with no regions, and the regions are copied only on an explicit `full`. The pin is outside the families the report ran. It is not a flake: its subject changed by ruling.

Patch round (one stroke, same branch):
1. Re-pin `recordDetailSections.agreement-12442.test.ts` to the contract after this PR: the seed-and-runtime agreement holds on the explicit-`full` path (the draft carries `kind: 'full'`), where the seeded `record:details` still carries the runtime's sections in the persisted shape and the CONTROL object with `fieldGroups` still seeds `{ group }` references; add one case that the default (no explicit `full`) seeds `kind: 'slotted'` with no regions — the agreement's new first half. Keep the "three call sites, one derivation" assertion as it is.
2. Run that file plus the suites the body names; rerun the derived gates on the final head; `--ran` reconciliation.
3. Push with a user token (the cloud session's pushes come through the Claude GitHub App, which does not fire this repository's PR workflows); report as a comment on #27054 (first line `os-dev-report`, round `patch round 1`).

Out-of-scope findings (two class a, reach measured through public doors) will be filed by the seat at ACCEPT: the page designer canvas drawing a location field as `[Object]` and a select value raw (pre-existing on `main`), and `InspectorJsonField`'s label not associated with its textarea. The Setup drawer's `relatedListFilter` JSON row: Acceptance notes.

Deviations recorded: the cloud session ran on Fable for its first minutes until the maintainer switched it to opus; it cannot receive this review, so the patch round runs as a local os-dev agent on the same branch under the same claim; `labels_add` 0 writes (none named).

## 席位核对 · PR #27163 ← #27054 · epic PM `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` · 2026-10-28T10:45Z

Verdict: **ACCEPT** — ordinary queue landing (governed register: 0 of 28 paths; `packages/spec` untouched; +1614 / −164, under the 3000-line threshold). Supersedes the REWORK above: the cloud session's build (report 6464856235) plus one local patch round (report 6466884994), both under the same claim.

Checklist, judged on GitHub and on the branch:
- Shape: draft → `main`; first line `Part of #27054` by design — the card's fifth item (the `relatedLists` drag-to-order editor) waits for #27069 to ship the key, as the card and the dispatch both say, so the card stays open behind that one; one closing-keyword scan clean; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in the body and in `.changeset/27054-studio-related-list-controls.md`. No `content/docs/releases/`.
- Scope: 27 files, all under `metadata-admin/**`, `studio-design/**` and the studio i18n namespace; the card's `field.form.ts` / `page.form.ts` rows are deliberately unchanged, with the measured reason (the Setup drawer's `SchemaForm` has no object-field context; plumbing one would re-bind every `*Field` row to the wrong object) — accepted: the builder lives where the three-state control lives, and the Setup drawer's JSON row is an acceptance note. The surface beyond the card (`PagePreview.tsx`, `PageBlockCanvas.tsx`, `createDerive.ts`, `registry.ts`, `widgets.tsx`, `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`, two new files) is named with its reason in the body.
- Patch round 1 (head `7731242e37`): `recordDetailSections.agreement-12442.test.ts` re-pinned to the contract — the seed-and-runtime agreement asserted on the explicit-`full` path through one `fullSeedFor` helper, a new case pinning that no kind or `slotted` seeds exactly `{ kind: 'slotted' }` with no `record:details` node, the three-call-sites block unchanged; `anchors.ts` untouched. Whole app-shell views directory 1246 files / 11776 tests green, so no other old pin conflicts with the new contract; ablation of the `'full'` argument reds the four explicit-full cases with the CI job's own signatures and restores to the HEAD blob.
- Spot checks (seat readings on `7731242e37`): `anchors.ts` seeds a record page as `kind: 'slotted'` unless the author picked `full`, and copies regions only then; `createDerive.ts` adds the `page-kind` transform (`record` → `slotted`, else `full`); `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` `RelatedListFields` reads `true` / absent as Show, writes `false` for Don't show and `'primary'` for Primary, deletes the key for Show, and is absent on `tree` fields; `relatedListFilter` goes through the shared `FilterConditionField` extracted from the dataset inspector, not a second builder.
- Rulings: Primary's label reads 「主要（进正文）」 per the v3 ruling; the #27069 reference sits in the code comment because runtime strings carry no tracker numbers here (AGENTS.md wins over the dispatch's wording) — accepted.
- Tests and gates: 198 files / 2268 tests on the touched families, app-shell + i18n type-check exit 0; 34 / 34 derived gates exit 0 with the `--ran` reconciliation quoted; two ablations (the slotted seed line, `convertToFull`'s persisted-shape conversion) each red on their pin and restored to the HEAD blob. Live Studio run on the showcase app caught and fixed the convert-to-full persisted-shape defect before the PR. Pinned to head `7731242e37`: 43 success, 11 skipped, 0 other — the nine required contexts all success, Test UI 16 / 16 shards. Verify lock: cloud container (no disclosure needed).
- Screenshots: evidence branch `claude/issue-27054-evidence` @ `bf202d60` (field inspector with Primary selected; create form switching to `slotted`; the designer's default-page note and Convert to full page; the converted page without a spec banner; the ordered highlight list) — read by the seat.
- Out-of-scope findings (two class a, reach measured through public doors): filed as #27177 (page designer canvas draws a location field as `[Object]` and a select value raw, pre-existing on `main`) and #27178 (`InspectorJsonField`'s label is not associated with its textarea). The Setup drawer's `relatedListFilter` JSON row: Acceptance notes.
- Deviations recorded: the cloud session ran on Fable for its first minutes until the maintainer switched it to opus; its pushes came through the Claude GitHub App, which does not fire this repository's PR workflows — the patch round's user-token push is what put the final head under CI; it cannot receive a review, so the patch round ran as a local os-dev agent on the same branch; `labels_add` 0 writes (none named).

Landing: ready + auto-merge in this stroke on the maintainer's standing authorization for this epic (verbatim, 2026-10-28: 「授权你用车队身份给 #26758 翻 ready 并挂 auto-merge（squash），后续本 epic 的 PR 复核 ACCEPT 后同样处理」). After MERGED the card stays open for its fifth item: `pm:dispatched` → `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: #27069`.
